title: Full school day cell phone bans are more popular than ever
summary: As schools across the country continue to implement cell phone bans, a new Pew Research Center survey shows they continue to gain support. Seventy-seven percent of US adults support banning cell phones in middle and high school classes, and 48 percent support banning them for the entire school day.
author: Lauren Feiner
